name: Obsidian Connector
description: REST-first OpenHanako connector for Obsidian vault operations, with the legacy Obsidian CLI proxy kept as a diagnostic fallback.

restBaseUrl.title: Local REST API base URL
restBaseUrl.description: Primary Obsidian Local REST API URL. HTTPS is preferred when available.

restFallbackBaseUrl.title: Local REST API fallback URL
restFallbackBaseUrl.description: Fallback Obsidian Local REST API URL, usually the insecure HTTP server.

restApiKey.title: Local REST API key
restApiKey.description: Optional API key. Prefer restApiKeyFile when possible so the key is not stored in plugin settings.

restApiKeyFile.title: Local REST API key file
restApiKeyFile.description: Optional path to a file containing either the API key or the Local REST API data.json.

defaultVaultPath.title: Default vault path
defaultVaultPath.description: Optional vault filesystem path used to auto-read .obsidian/plugins/obsidian-local-rest-api/data.json for the REST API key.

restRejectUnauthorized.title: Reject self-signed HTTPS certificate
restRejectUnauthorized.description: Set true only if the Obsidian Local REST API certificate is trusted by the runtime. Defaults false for the plugin's self-signed certificate.

restTransport.title: REST transport
restTransport.description: HTTP transport for obsidian_rest. auto tries native Node HTTP first, then a controlled curl subprocess if the runtime blocks local networking.

obsidianBinaryPath.title: Legacy Obsidian CLI binary path
obsidianBinaryPath.description: Legacy diagnostic fallback only. The native Obsidian CLI may SIGSEGV in HanaAgent sandboxes; prefer obsidian_rest.

defaultVault.title: Legacy CLI default vault
defaultVault.description: Optional Obsidian vault name passed to the legacy obsidian_cli tool.

timeoutMs.title: Default timeout
timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for each REST or legacy CLI call.

maxOutputChars.title: Max returned output characters
maxOutputChars.description: Long stdout/stderr is truncated before returning to the agent.
